MINIMUM QUALIFYING CRITERIA: - The Firm/Company, as the case may be (hereinafter referred to as "The Tenderer/Bidder"), shall have following Minimum Eligible Qualification: The Tenderer/Bidder must fulfil the following qualifying requirements to consider him technically qualified and eligible for opening its Price-Tender/Bid and for award of Work. 1.1 Financial Turnover: The Average Annual financial turnover of the tenderer during the last thre e years, ending 31st March 2026, should not be less than Rs.8,14,404/- Without Tax. The tenderer shall f urnish necessary details as per Section-VII: Schedule B of the tender document. In support of this, the Ten derer should submit copies of audited P&L A/c statements and Balance sheets for last 03 Financial Years i. e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26, with UDIN number and duly certified by the Chartered Accountant (C.A.) cl early indicating Membership and registration number. 1.2 Past Works Experience: The tenderer should have successfully completed similar work/s i.e., Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning of Hydraulic Lifts OR Major Repair & Upgradation of Hydraulic Lifts OR Service AMC of Hydraulic Lifts, years ending on the last day of month previous to the one in which tenders are invited, shall be any of the following: i. Three completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.10,85,872/- each with out tax. OR ii. Two completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.13,57,341/- each withou t tax. OR iii. One completed work costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.21,71,745/-each without tax. And The work orders of qualifying above criteria shall be back up with satisfactory operation after installation for a period of at least 03 year. Certificate to that effect from the client may be submitte d in technical bid. If order is executed for private Party TDS certificate is required for the same order.

The tenderer shall furnish the documentary evidence to show that they have executed mentioned works s uccessfully & satisfactorily along with lift in service/operation satisfactorily for a period of at least three ye ars. In addition to this, the tenderer shall also enclose the copy/copies payment received towards the orde r placed to demonstrate completion of the order or orders under consideration or Certificate showing satisf actory completion of work. If order is executed for private Party TDS certificate is required for the same or der. 1.3 Supporting Documents: The Tenderer/Bidder shall furnish the documentary evidence to sho w that they have executed mentioned works successfully & satisfactorily. The Tenderer/Bidder should furni sh the information as per SCHEDULE VII-DETAILS OF WORK COMPLETED IN PAST / VIII-EXPERIENCE IN SIMIL AR WORK of the Tender/ Bid document. In support of this, the Tender/Bidder shall submit the order copy/c opies in full along with relevant annexures/documents forming the part of the order or orders. In addition t o this, the Tender/Bidder shall also enclose the copy/copies payment received towards the order placed to demonstrate completion of the order or orders under consideration or Certificate showing satisfactory com pletion of work. If order is executed for private Party TDS certificate is required for the same order. ADDITIONAL e PERFORMANCE GURANTEE (ePG) The additional Bank Guarantee as given below shall be submitted within 21 days from the date of issue of l etter of acceptance (LOA) or work order as acceptance of the Tender/Bid by Demand Draft in favour of JNP A or in the form of e Bank Guarantee, on any Nationalized / Scheduled Bank having its branch in Mumbai o r by Insurance Surety Bond or by Online mode i.e RTGS/NIFT valid for 63 months. Bids below 10% of estimate: Nil Bids below 10% to 30% of estimate: 10% of total contract cost Bids below 30% to 40% of estimate: 15% of total contract cost The Additional Bank Guarantee shall be in force from the date of letter of acceptance/ work order and the s ame has to be extended for a further period as required by JNPA. Any expenditure in this regard will be bo rne by the Contractor. The Proforma of Bank Guarantee for Performance Guarantee is given in the tender/b id document as Annexure-I. If the successful Tender/Bidder fails to submit the additional Performance Guarantee in the stipulated perio d of 21 days from the date of receipt of LOA/work order, EMD of successful Tender/Bidder is liable to be for feited. Bidders should upload break up of price ONLY in Pdf format and in the Price Bid. 1. EMD and Security Deposit (Performance Security) shall be accepted only the following modes: · NEFT / RTGS · E-Bank Guarantee · Insurance Surety Bond 2. Submission of EMD and Security Deposit (Performance Security) through Cheque or Demand Draft s hall n ot be accepted under any circumstances. 3. No hard copy of E-BG is required at JNPA office. 4. No Bank Guarantee in the physical form will be accepted. 5. E-BG will be issued directly by the bank via NeSL. 6. E-BG is a fully valid form of document.

The Bidders are requested to reach the Bank with following details and issue the E-BG in favour of JNP A: · Entity Name: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. · PAN/UIN: AAALJ0036D · Bank Name: Bank of Baroda · Account No.: 27410100022333 · IFSC Code: BARB0NERULX · Email ID: dgmfin2@jnport.gov.in · Mobile No.: 9869251006 NOTE: Multiple bids received from same IP address will not be considered for further evaluatio n . 3.
